verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at doc.anytype.io (HTTP 200) indexing the docs as raw .md pages, which an agent can ingest directly. Agent-oriented material is also present: an agents skill toolkit for Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools, an AGENTS.md in the main repo, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec on the developer portal. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and no evidence of an llms.txt or llms-full.txt for the developer/API portal.
